# GitHub Social Preview

`bailinghub-social-preview.svg` is generated by `scripts/generate-readme-assets.mjs`.
Run `npm run assets:generate` after changing its copy or layout, and use
`npm run assets:check` to verify that the checked-in SVG is current.

GitHub requires a raster image for the repository Social Preview setting. Export
the SVG to PNG only as an upload artifact; do not commit that PNG to this directory.
